household.title: stool
household.reason: A carved wooden stool with a circular seat, decorated support pillars, and circular base—a classic Southern African headrest/stool form consistent with Kalanga craft traditions in Zimbabwe; museum attributes it directly to Kalanga makers.

household.reason: A carved wooden headrest with a curved top, pedestal base, and dot-ornamented supports — a classic Southern African headrest form, and the museum attributes it specifically to the Kalanga makers. This is a plausible, well-attested household/personal object for this people.
